text:
Kalanoro - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018391/

🎤✨ *Play Kalanoro now on PlayStation 5*

Hop on a colorful action-adventure inspired by Malagasy folklore. Recruit legendary lemur musicians, grow your band's fame across Lemuria, and challenge the evil witch Raneny in a quest to save the island—one song at a time!

🐒 *Welcome to Lemuria*
Once a paradise, the island of Lemuria now suffers under the witch Raneny’s ruthless rule. Having grown tired of exploiting its people, she decided to host a huge concert with the island’s most famous band. You’re sent on a mission to fight back by rallying legendary musicians to your cause!

🎶 *Dancing Through Joyful Chaos*
Dash through diverse biomes, save and befriend funky locals to form your crew, and jump over industrial platforming traps to become Lemuria’s number one band and finally face Raneny. Defeat her minions in fast-paced combat, using hair-based powers and improvised weapons (slippers included) to fight epic and groovy boss battles and free the island!

🎵 *Original Music:* *Lemuria Banana* – Ando Lalaina
© Universal Music Publishing, Push It Group
